paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.27% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.53%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.55%). Brent crude changed +0.02% to 95.84. Gold changed +0.03% to 3,886.3. Bitcoin changed +1.38% to 65,011.1797. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.154%, a relative move of +1.00%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-2.40%) and Invesco (+2.35%) moved the most.
